metadata.source: J. K. Wahlstrand, Y.-H. Cheng, H. M. Milchberg. Absolute measurement of the transient optical nonlinearity in N2, O2, N2O, and Ar. Phys. Rev. A 85, 043820 (2012) (https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.85.043820); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description:
40 fs. Single-shot supercontinuum spectral interferometry. Room temperature, atmospheric pressure.
For long pulses, the effective nonlinearity coefficient can be calculated as n2,eff = n2/0.04, where n2 is the reported instantaneous nonlinear refractive index.
